source_artifact.source_type: private Telegram export supplied by the operator

firsthand_platform_statements.speaker: Auri_0x
firsthand_platform_statements.summary: The starter uses an LLM for strategy and a deterministic executor for moment-to-moment actions.

firsthand_platform_statements.speaker: Auri_0x
firsthand_platform_statements.summary: The LLM emits focus, target, and preferred action kinds; choose() ranks candidates, applies safety and loop rules, and emits an exact offered LegalAction ID.

firsthand_platform_statements.speaker: Auri_0x
firsthand_platform_statements.summary: The starter's rules and action weights came from more than a month of scenario-level A/B testing.

firsthand_platform_statements.speaker: Auri_0x
firsthand_platform_statements.summary: The executor can override model suggestions that violate hard-coded rules.
Qualification failures were tied to absent legal actions, a 120-second non-response, and one reproduced JavaScript syntax crash.
Auri described offline fuzzing, replay mining, and stored per-decision data as available learning infrastructure.

participant_analysis.speaker: Odin Free
participant_analysis.summary: Daveey's transferable edge was described as a policy factory with structured variants, many rounds and seats, rapid promotion, and simple score-producing loops.
participant_analysis.provenance_boundary: This is Odin's analysis, not a firsthand statement by Daveey. Policy families, cadence, and replay metrics are testable; hidden implementation and cross-game objective compression remain unresolved.

participant_analysis.speaker: Auri_0x
participant_analysis.summary: Auri asked why Daveey showed no fallbacks.
participant_analysis.provenance_boundary: Fallback flags are not comparable until both policies use the same telemetry definition; deterministic recovery may be labeled as fallback in one policy and not another.

operator_relayed_odin_take.summary: Daveey wins through a fast tested playbook rather than model deliberation on every turn: one early City, near-continuous expansion or attacks, delayed optional diplomacy and upgrades, deterministic exact actions, and model reasoning between matches.
operator_relayed_odin_take.odin_lane_plan: Odin intends to test this independently as OS1 against his v89 champion.
operator_relayed_odin_take.hrafn_boundary: This is coordination context supplied by the operator, not a formal Odin approval and not authority for Hrafn to touch OS1, v89, or the qd1n lane.

operator_relayed_wrapper_audit.provenance_boundary: The operator supplied this audit from another Codex wrapper. Hrafn records its claims and caveats but did not independently rerun the qd1n-side collection in this checkpoint.

supported: Developer learning through replay collection, evaluation, controller revision, and new version uploads.
In-game adaptation by a fixed controller reacting to changing board state.
learning_taxonomy.not_established: Online learning that updates persistent parameters or memory between matches.

v22_to_v24_visible_changes: Reason prefix changed from WC22 to WC24.
First City moved from approximately turn 900 to turn 800.
Early social actions fell from 2.7 percent to 0.7 percent.
Median response latency fell from 4 ms to 2 ms.

fixed_v24_evidence.interpretation: The outcome lift is real but uncontrolled across opponents, seeds, seats, and spawn geometry. Stable opening behavior and reason families do not show parameter updates.

executor_evidence.planner_error_direction: Exposed planner errors rose from 16.5 percent to 21.6 percent while results improved and exact actions remained fast and accepted.
executor_evidence.inference: A fast fixed executor continued playing when the optional planner was unavailable.

persistence_boundary.hosted_runtime: One short-lived digest-pinned player container per episode, restart policy Never, with no player persistent volume.
persistence_boundary.consequence: Cross-match online learning would require an external database or service. No public replay, repository, or Telegram artifact establishes that Daveey used one.

corrections: brainType external-http is a generic Coworld bridge label and is not Daveey-specific.
The Telegram note about a workflow not accruing learnings was written by Calcutator, not Daveey.
operator_relayed_wrapper_audit.hrafn_consequence: Keep the live container deterministic and stateless. Accumulate learnings in committed replay/evaluation artifacts, use model analysis between matches, and promote only measured controller revisions.

architectural_implication.supported: Keep model intelligence off the exact-ID critical path. Use deterministic offered-action selection, safety checks, loop control, and bounded latency online; use models and automated analysis to generate hypotheses and revise measured policy components offline.
architectural_implication.not_supported: The export does not identify Daveey's internal architecture and does not prove that copying Auri's starter unchanged will match Daveey.
architectural_implication.pure_llm_test_role: Shadow or ablation only, gated on invalid-ID rate, timeout rate, decision-latency tail, context drift, and matched replay outcome before any live authority.

cross_game_summary.aggregation_caveat: Unweighted rank counts only. Games differ in entrants, episodes, ties, score direction, and leaderboard aggregation; scores are not pooled.

proxywar_replay_pattern.scope: Public official replay rows for daveey-proxywar:v22, rounds 476-495.

inference.supported: Daveey's transferable advantage is a rapid empirical loop plus game-specific policies: low idle in opening and conversion, neutral compounding, adaptive retargeting toward stronger windows, harder commitment at favorable ratios, and fast single-mechanism replacement.
inference.not_supported: One hidden tactic or one policy copied unchanged across games.
inference.online_learning_assessment: Public evidence supports development-level learning and fixed-controller in-game adaptation. It does not establish persistent self-training between matches.
inference.hrafn_adaptation: Copy the loop, not the code. Keep separate map arms and test one replay-visible mechanism against an exact parent before promotion.

limitations: Current ranks can move during collection.
No public Daveey replay rows were returned outside Proxywar under current access.
Cross-game action behavior remains unresolved; rankings, policy specialization, and iteration cadence are the cross-game evidence.
The later v24 and Coworld persistence audit was supplied by the operator from another Codex wrapper and was not independently rerun by Hrafn in this checkpoint.
